title: Nis2EntityClassification
description: NIS2-sourced archetype — entity classification under Directive (EU) 2022/2555. Determines whether an entity falls under NIS2 scope and at what obligation tier. Rootless — regulatory scoping dimension. Source: NIS2 Article 3 (essential and important entities) + Annexes I/II.

entityTier.description: NIS2 obligation tier. ESSENTIAL: entities in Annex I sectors exceeding medium-size thresholds, or designated by Member State. IMPORTANT: entities in Annex I/II sectors meeting medium-size thresholds but not classified as essential. OUT_OF_SCOPE: does not meet NIS2 applicability criteria. Source: NIS2 Art 3(1), Art 3(2).

sizeCategory.description: Entity size per Recommendation 2003/361/EC. MEDIUM and above triggers NIS2 applicability for entities in Annex I/II sectors. Source: NIS2 Art 2(1).

memberStateDesignation.description: Whether the entity has been explicitly designated as essential by a Member State regardless of size, per Art 2(2) exceptions (sole provider, disruption with significant impact, public administration).

memberState.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the Member State under whose jurisdiction the entity falls. Source: NIS2 Art 26 (jurisdiction).
